add_l2_weight_decay: add L2 weight decay regularization to an existing ENN loss function with a configurable scale
combine_losses: combine multiple weighted loss functions into a single combined loss using CombineLossConfig
combine_losses_no_state: combine multiple stateless loss functions into a single weighted loss for stateless ENN training
add_data_noise: apply a data noise function to each batch before computing the single loss
l2_weights_with_predicate: compute the sum of squared parameter weights filtered by an optional predicate function
